name: notii
description: Your Notii notes, tasks and calendar in ChatGPT: find answers in your notes, save conversations as notes, plan your day and tick off tasks.

interface.longDescription: Notii is a notes app with notebooks, checklists, daily notes, Kanban boards and a calendar. Connect your Notii account to search and read your notes and the projects shared with you, save conversations and web pages as notes, add and tick off tasks, plan your day from your calendar and daily note, set reminders and update board cards. Notii only sees and changes what your connected account can; disconnect it any time in Notii's Settings.
defaultPrompt: Save the key points of this chat to Notii
What did I decide about the launch?

positive.description: Save a new note from a request in the chat. Run first: cases 2 and 5 use what it makes.
positive.prompt: Save a note in Notii titled "Team offsite ideas" with three ideas: a hiking day, a cooking class and a board game night.
positive.expected_behavior: A note titled "Team offsite ideas" is created in the account's default notebook with the three ideas as a list. ChatGPT confirms it was saved and links to the note (https://app.notii.io/notes/…), which opens in Notii.

positive.description: Answer a question from the user's notes, with a link to the note it comes from.
positive.prompt: Search my Notii notes for the team offsite. What ideas did I write down?
positive.expected_behavior: Notii finds the "Team offsite ideas" note (from case 1, or the demo account's sample note of that name) and ChatGPT lists its ideas: a hiking day, a cooking class and a board game night, with a link to the note.

positive.description: Add a dated task to the user's daily note.
positive.prompt: Add a task to my Notii daily note for tomorrow: Call the venue about the offsite.
positive.expected_behavior: "Call the venue about the offsite" is added as an unchecked checklist item on tomorrow's daily note (made if it doesn't exist yet). ChatGPT confirms the day and links to the daily note.

positive.description: Plan the day from the daily note, open tasks and the calendar.
positive.prompt: What's on my plate today in Notii?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT summarizes today from Notii: the daily note, tasks due today or overdue, and today's calendar events (the demo account's sample tasks and events). With nothing due, it says the day is clear. It changes nothing.

positive.description: Check off a task the user names.
positive.prompt: In Notii, mark the task "Call the venue about the offsite" as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Notii finds the open task from case 3 and checks it off; ChatGPT confirms it's done and which note it's in. Asked again, it says the task is already done.

negative.description: "Note" here means a message to write, not something to keep in Notii. ChatGPT should just draft the text in the chat and call no Notii tool; it may offer to save it to Notii, but saves only if the user then asks.
negative.prompt: Write a short note to my neighbor apologizing for the noise last night.

negative.description: A general question about note-taking apps, answered from general knowledge. Nothing in the user's Notii account is needed, so no Notii tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What are the best note-taking apps for students?

negative.description: "Remind me" here means "tell me", not "set a reminder". ChatGPT should answer (Canberra) and not call Notii's set_reminder or add_task.
negative.prompt: Remind me what the capital of Australia is.

publication.release_notes: Notii's first release in ChatGPT. Search and read your notes and shared projects, save conversations and web pages as notes, add and check off tasks, plan your day from your daily note and calendar, set reminders and update board cards. Results show as Notii cards with links back to your notes.
